title: Isolation claim residency sentinel and evidence lifecycle
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a Residency Sentinel service that continuously asserts tenant residency and isolation for Dedicated capacity and emits tamper-evident evidence bundles. The sentinel will: 1) sample node attachment and geolocation metadata, 2) reconcile against tenant residency policies, 3) sign snapshots with tenant-scoped KMS keys, and 4) push retention-tiered evidence bundles to the compliance store. Goal: provide daily signed attestations + on-demand snapshot for auditors with retention lifecycle management and automated report generation.
tasks: Design snapshot schema (node id, region, AZ, container image digest, kernel sigs, timestamp, routing policy) and evidence bundle layout
Prototype signer integration using tenant KMS key per Dedicated contract (fallback to platform key with rotation audit)
Implement sampling agent for Dedicated nodes (lightweight, stateless) and verification worker in control plane
Evidence bundler: compression, metadata index, and deterministic canonicalization for reproducible signing
Retention lifecycle: S3 lifecycle rules + verifiable tombstone creation for deleted/expired bundles
Integrate with audit UI and automated weekly compliance report generator
Add monitoring: freshness, signing success rate, bundle size, and geo drift alerts to Grafana and PagerDuty rules
E2E test harness and synthetic tenant to validate stale/misreported node scenarios
acceptance_criteria: Daily sentinel snapshot is generated for every active Dedicated tenant and stored in compliance bucket
Each snapshot bundle is signed with a key traceable to the tenant or to a clearly recorded platform fallback (KMS key id in metadata)
Retention lifecycle rules applied correctly: evidence older than retention window is tombstoned and deleted according to policy; tombstones are auditable
Admin Console shows last successful snapshot timestamp, bundle hash, and link to downloadable bundle for each tenant
Automated report generation produces a PDF summarizing 30-days of snapshots and geo drift flags
Grafana dashboard exposes sentinel metrics and fires an alert if signing failures exceed 1% over 24h or if any tenant has >3 mismatched-region samples
